== Notes ==
* Even if the casting time of a spell is to be reduced to 0 by this spell, the spell cannot be activated while [[Movement|moving]] or while activating another [[skill]] and [[aftercast delay]] will still occur.
* The cast time reduction applies before effects that lengthen it, like [[Nature's Renewal]].
{{anomaly|Similar to other [[Enchantment spell#Characteristics|enchantments that target a foe]], foes affected by [[Well of the Profane]] or [[spirit]]s cannot be targeted by this enchantment.}}

== Trivia ==
* [[w:Jaundice|Jaundice]] is a yellow discoloration of the eyes and skin, usually a symptom of diseases that interfere with the breakdown of red blood cells.
